cost_scopes.child: full native child observation including local diagnostics and process overhead
cost_scopes.consumer_run_tree: consumer.run() through before final report write; excludes Python startup/import/exit; parent plus all children once
cost_scopes.core: local producer (setup plus all attempts/searches) + all measured native verifier calls + typed product copy
cost_scopes.core_exclusions: scalar reference, diagnostic record build/serialization, Python consumer, input/model load, process overhead, WAN, other independent validators, real stales/competing miners, energy
cost_scopes.outer_consumer_tree: full observed consumer process tree including startup/import/exit; includes inner consumer and native work; never add those again
cost_scopes.output_credit: one fixed 64-request material cohort and one output; 30 completed observations are research repetitions, not 30 new service batches
cost_scopes.subset_aliases: setup is inside producer; all native/diagnostic work is inside child; child is inside consumer/outer scope; these columns are not additive

fanout_scope: N=3/8 are actual sequential full replay calls in one process; independent-validator population remains unknown

hypothetical_scenarios.name: one-verifier-no-stale-assumption
hypothetical_scenarios.scope: hypothetical linear fanout and iid whole-batch stale retry sensitivity

hypothetical_scenarios.scope: hypothetical linear fanout and iid whole-batch stale retry sensitivity

hypothetical_scenarios.scope: hypothetical linear fanout and iid whole-batch stale retry sensitivity

hypothetical_scenarios.name: one-hundred-verifiers-ten-percent-iid-stale-assumption
hypothetical_scenarios.scope: hypothetical linear fanout and iid whole-batch stale retry sensitivity

measurement_limitations.host_scope: shared local host; no independent administrators or WAN
measurement_limitations.noise_attribution: audit overlap is one recorded concurrent activity, not the sole known or inferred source of shared-host variability
measurement_limitations.overlap_scope: recorded read-only audit window; per-case absolute intervals are not in the campaign records, so affected cases are not inferred

outer_research_case_cost.scope: sum of 31 separately observed consumer case envelopes, including exhaustion; excludes campaign-driver overhead, intercase gaps, security experiment, builds and reader audits; not a single-inference cost

reuse_scope: four challenge cycles reexecute the same material output; 20 winning proofs do not create four useful business batches

partial_processes.local_pipe_scope: one finished local child exchange; result was not credited

security.cache_scope: software exact-fact cache; owner recreation is not a physical power-loss recovery measurement
security.cost_scope: five tile workflows only; native subphases and exchange wall are contained, not extra additive costs
security.scope: finite offline same-material experiment; caller-trusted native binary; clocks are not attestation

statistics.arm_summary: three separate observed repetitions: min, median, max
statistics.paired_summary: median of the three per-round sparse/dense ratios; never ratio of arm medians
statistics.ratios: exact numerator/denominator; CPU/CPU or wall/wall only
statistics.uncertainty: finite shared-host observations; no confidence interval, independent replication, or qualification
